data.title: Care level 2 decision (Pflegegrad 2)
data.summary: The care insurance fund (Pflegekasse bei der Beispiel Ersatzkasse) granted care level 2 from 1 February 2025 and denied the requested care level 3. It will pay care allowance of €347.00 per month.
data.explanation: Your care insurance has recognised care level 2 (Pflegegrad 2) from 1 February 2025, based on the Medical Service's assessment. Care level 3, which you applied for, was not granted because the assessment gave 38.75 weighted points. You will receive care allowance (Pflegegeld) of €347.00 each month, paid at month end, as long as you arrange your care yourself. If you think the decision is wrong, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or in person at the fund; the app shows the deadline. Consider getting advice from a care counselling service if you object.
data.tax_note: Care allowance and care level notices may matter for the tax return (e.g. care-related costs or lump sums); keep this notice.

items.title: Objection against care level decision

date.text: innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe des Bescheids

items.action: If you disagree with the decision (e.g. care level 3 denied), file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or in person at the care fund.
items.consequence: After the deadline the decision becomes final and can no longer be challenged.
items.quote: Halten Sie die Entscheidung für falsch, legen Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe des Bescheids Widerspruch ein – schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Pflegekasse bei der Beispiel Ersatzkasse.

items.title: Care allowance received monthly
items.action: Expect the care allowance (Pflegegeld) paid into your account at each month end.
items.quote: Wir zahlen es jeweils zum Monatsende auf Ihr Konto.
